verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt file at ellisporter.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), so this law firm's site does expose a machine-readable entry point an agent can be pointed at. The visible content is only a brief firm overview, and nothing shows richer agent-oriented documentation behind it. Missing for 10: evidence of substantive llms.txt content or linked agent-oriented docs, first-party documentation of the file's purpose, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent usability.
